## Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(emmeans)

library(treemap)
library(gt)
```

## Read data
```{r}

Whale<-read.csv("Data/Humpback.csv") %>% filter(length.m.>0) %>% filter(Year>=1949 & Year <=1965)
Whale$sex<-factor(Whale$sex, levels = c("Male", "Female", "Hermaphrodite", "Unknown"))

Whale_62<-filter(Whale,Year==1962)


Whale_49<-filter(Whale,Year==1949)
```

## Data used
```{r}
head(Whale, 10)
```


### Plot % Male vs Year
```{r}
male_year<-Whale %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Prop_male=sum(sex=="Male")/n(),n=n())%>%
  filter(Year>=1949 & Year<=1962)

ggplot(male_year, aes(x=Year,y=Prop_male),)+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 0.5,colour = "red", se = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y=0.5), linetype=2)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.25,0.90))+
  labs(x="Year",y="% Male")+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1950,1964,by=2))+
    ggtitle("Whales observed in Australia over time: % Male")
```

```{r}
Whale %>%
  filter(Year==1962) %>%
    group_by(Year,sex) %>%
      summarise(n=n()) %>%
        mutate(percentage=scales::percent(n/sum(n),0.1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gt()


```

## Permutation test 10000 permutations
```{r}

set.seed(216486)

heads<-data.frame(Males=rbinom(10000,720,0.5))

pl1<-ggplot(heads, aes(x=Males))+
  geom_bar()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 409, linetype=2,colour = "red")+
  labs(x="Number of Males",y="Number of Simulations")

pl1

table(heads>=409)

```

## Density and Cumulative distribution funcion
```{r fig3, out.width="80%", echo = FALSE}

tots<- seq(1:720)
binomial.df<-dbinom(tots,720,0.5)
cumbinomial.df<-pbinom(tots,720,0.5)

distr.ft<-data.frame(tots, binomial.df, cumbinomial.df)

pl2 <- ggplot(distr.ft, aes(x=tots, y=binomial.df))+
  geom_line()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(300,420))+
  labs(x="Num. of Males",y="Proportion")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 409, linetype=2,colour = "red")

pl2


pl3 <- ggplot(distr.ft, aes(x=tots, y=cumbinomial.df))+
  geom_line()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(300,420))+
  labs(x="Number of Males",y="Cumulative Proportion")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 409, linetype=2,colour = "red")

pl3

plot_grid(pl2, pl3, labels = c('A', 'B'), label_size = 12)
```

## 2-sided p-value - density function
```{r, out.width="80%", echo = FALSE}
pl2+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 720-409, linetype=2,colour = "red")

```


## p-value to test p_M=0.5
```{r}
prop.test(409,720, p=0.5)

```

## 95% Confidence Interval to test 2 Ho
```{r}
mean_length <- mean(Whale_49$length.m., na.rm = TRUE)
sd_length <- sd(Whale_49$length.m., na.rm = TRUE)
n <- sum(!is.na(Whale_49$length.m.))
se <- sd_length / sqrt(n)

# 95% Confidence Interval
alpha <- 0.05
t_critical <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df = n - 1)
lower_ci <- mean_length - t_critical * se
upper_ci <- mean_length + t_critical * se

# Print the CI
cat("95% Confidence Interval: [", lower_ci, ",", upper_ci, "]\n")

# Create a plot of the mean with its confidence interval
ggplot(data = data.frame(mean = mean_length, lower = lower_ci, upper = upper_ci), aes(x = 1, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.1) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 13, linetype=2,colour = "blue")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 13.2, linetype=2,colour = "red")+
  labs(
    title = "95% Confidence Interval of Length and Ho",
    x = "",
    y = "Length"
  )
```


## 1-sample t-test
```{r}
Whale_49 %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
      summarise(n=n(),"Mean Length"=mean(length.m.),"SD Length"=sd(length.m.)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gt()%>%
    fmt_number(columns =  3:4,decimals = 2)

Whale_49 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=length.m.))+
  geom_bar()+
  xlab("Length (m)")+
  ylab("Count")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 13.01,col="red",linewidth=2)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 13.0,col="blue",linewidth=2,linetype=2)

t.test(Whale_49$length.m.,mu = 13.0)


t.test(Whale_49$length.m.,mu = 13.0, conf.level = 0.99)

t.test()

```


## 2-sample t-test
```{r}
Whale_49 %>%
    group_by(sex) %>%
      summarise(n=n(),"Mean Length"=mean(length.m.),"SD Length"=sd(length.m.)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gt()%>%
    fmt_number(columns =  3:4,decimals = 2)


Whale_49 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=length.m., group = sex))+
  geom_bar()+
  xlab("Length (m)")+
  ylab("Count")+
  facet_wrap(~sex,nrow =2)


t.test(length.m.~sex, data=Whale_49)
```


## F-test to compare 2 variances
```{r}
var.test(length.m.~sex, data=Whale_49)
```

prop.test(10, n=10, p=0.5)
